levels.font: L1 — font-wide defaults and metadata on the host
levels.slot: L2 — slot and parent-slot values on the host (re-declared on nodes by jamo/context rules)
levels.role: L2 — role values on the host; the last fallback of every slot chain
levels.jamo: L3 — accumulating corrections declared on jamo nodes in font-kku.jamo
levels.context: L4 — accumulating corrections declared on jamo nodes in font-kku.context
levels.tune: L5 — hand corrections over a fixed glyph shape (ADR-030): shape values declared on jamo nodes in font-kku.tune, after the generated font-kku.shape values
levels.page: page-only overrides; fonts must not declare them
levels.runtime: written by font-kku.js; neither fonts nor pages declare them
levels.dispatch: computed by the generated core dispatch; internal

variables.name: --fy-font-family
variables.default: "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans CJK KR", sans-serif

variables.name: --fy-selection
variables.default: rgb(from Highlight r g b / min(alpha, 0.6))

tokens.meaning: choseong beside a vertical or split vowel
